0022600117.text: The Detroit Pistons, now 2-0 and first in the Central and the East, visit the 3-0 Philadelphia 76ers, who lead the Atlantic and sit second in the East on a three-game winning streak. Detroit is missing Ausar Thompson (ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness), Joel Embiid (heel), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), with VJ Edgecombe day-to-day with an abdomen bruise and a game-time decision. The Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 4-0 and beat the 76ers 116-93 in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
